args.query: Was there a FedEx delivery disruption in Phoenix, Arizona on or around 2024-05-14?

content.summary: No documented FedEx delivery disruption in Phoenix was found for May 14, 2024 or within two days of that date; the May 14 notice described an interruption in the test environment for FedEx APIs, not package delivery service.

basis.reasoning: The FedEx notice identifies the May 14 interruption as occurring in the test environment and lists affected API functionality. It does not document a carrier delivery disruption affecting Phoenix, so this notice does not meet the stated criterion.
